document-cassio-v1-complete-operating-ma.title: CASSIO V1 Complete Operating Manual
document-cassio-v1-complete-operating-ma.content: Canonical 50-page V1 product/operating spec for CASSIO: browser-based pocket synth/sampler/looper (no MIDI/USB workflow). Freezes the physical front panel (display, M1/M2 context knobs, M3=master volume, soft keys A-D, pads 1-6, BACK/MENU, D-pad+OK, STOP/PLAY/REC/TAP, mini keyboard, onboard mic). Scope covers performance, sound library, shaping (filter, A/R, two-band EQ, simple reverb/delay), mic/file sampling, 6-track loop (record/overdub/replace/mute/solo/undo), 6-lane 16-step sequencer, mixer, projects, and settings. Documents six top-level menu areas (PLAY/LOOP/SOUND/MIX/PROJECT/SETTINGS), Screens 01–38 with hardware mappings, plus appendices for factory content, library rules, sound-engine semantics, recording behavior, persistence (IndexedDB/OPFS recommended), and V1 boundaries. Hardware verdict: panel is sufficient; future work is digital UI, assets, and Web Audio engine.

concept-v1-scope.title: V1 Scope capabilities
concept-v1-scope.content: CASSIO V1 freezes the physical panel. Capabilities: Performance (chromatic mini keyboard, octave, hold, factory/user sounds, 6 pads); Sound library (factory, user, mic recordings, imports, favorites); Sound shaping (filter/shape, attack/release, two-band bass/treble EQ, simple reverb/delay); Sampling (mic record, file import, trim, normalize, reverse, tune, root note, one-shot/gate/loop, save/assign); Looping (6 tracks: record/overdub/replace/mute/solo/undo, monitoring, length, count-in, quantize); Sequencing (6-lane step sequencer, 16-step base page, pattern length, swing, gate, velocity/accent/tie); Mixing (track level/pan, mute/solo, master output); Projects (new/save/save-as/open/rename, automatic recovery); System (master bass/treble EQ, metronome, brightness, storage, mic permissions). Per-sound EQ: M1=Bass M2=Treble -12..+12 dB (low/high shelf). Settings>Audio has second master Bass/Treble after mixer.

concept-hardware-front-panel.title: Front panel control vocabulary
concept-hardware-front-panel.content: Permanent controls: Display (screens + contextual labels); M1 context param 1; M2 context param 2; M3 master output volume in V1; soft keys A-D (labels on screen); Pads 1-6 (performance; may become lane select); BACK/MENU (tap=back/cancel, hold=main menu); D-pad+OK (focus, values, enter, confirm); STOP (stop transport, playhead to start; hold=all-notes-off panic); PLAY (play/pause loop or pattern); REC (record; during playback enter/leave overdub); TAP (tap tempo; hold=metronome toggle); Keyboard (current keyboard sound); Onboard mic (sampler source; monitor off by default). M1/M2 preferred as endless encoders. Enclosure-level (not front-panel workflow): mic, power, charging, audio out. Product subtitle: POCKET SYNTH / SAMPLER (not MIDI).

concept-global-behavior.title: Global control behavior
concept-global-behavior.content: Everywhere: M1/M2 change the two named top-of-display params (turning opens temporary value overlay). M3 always master volume — never saved track level or sample amplitude. BACK tap leave/cancel/up; hold opens main menu from anywhere. UP/DOWN lists/rows; LEFT/RIGHT horizontal/cursor/discrete values; OK enter/toggle/confirm. A-D execute bottom labels (blank=noop). PLAY start/pause; while stopped begins at start. STOP stop+return to beginning; hold STOP all-notes-off panic. REC from stopped: count-in then record selected loop track; while playing: overdub; during record: leave record keep playback. TAP: 2+ taps set BPM; hold TAP toggles metronome. Keyboard playable on performance/edit unless modal. Pads trigger assigned sounds unless screen says LANE/PAD SELECT. Status bar: BPM + battery; play/record symbol; no USB/MIDI status in V1.

concept-navigation-map.title: Six top-level areas and workflows
concept-navigation-map.content: Hold BACK/MENU enters six areas: PLAY, LOOP, SOUND, MIX, PROJECT, SETTINGS. Branches: PLAY->Library->Sound Detail->Sound Edit/Pad Assign. LOOP->Tracks->Track Menu / Loop Options / Sequencer->Step Edit. SOUND->Sound Library / Sampler->Mic or File Import->Sample Editor->Save Sample. MIX->six-track level/pan mixer. PROJECT->list->Save/Save As/Rename/New. SETTINGS->Audio/Metronome/Display/Storage/Permissions/About. Fast workflows: Play a sound: Boot->PLAY->D LIBRARY->choose->OK->A USE KEYS. Record mic: Hold MENU->SOUND->D SAMPLER->A MIC->REC->STOP->edit->save. Import: Hold MENU->SOUND->SAMPLER->B FILE->D OPEN->edit->save. Make a loop: Hold MENU->LOOP->select track->REC->perform->REC exit overdub. Step program: LOOP->B SEQ->pad lane->arrows step->OK toggle. Save project: Hold MENU->PROJECT->B SAVE (+ text entry if naming).

concept-factory-library.title: Factory sound library (Appendix A)
concept-factory-library.content: Factory sounds are read-only; editing creates a User copy. KEYS — Warm EP Tone/Tremolo; Toy Piano Color/Decay; Tape Piano Age/Space; Soft Organ Tone/Rotary; Bell Keys Brightness/Release; Lo-Fi Keys Filter/Wow. DRUMS — Kick01 Tone/Decay; Kick02 Punch/Decay; Snare01 Tone/Snap; Snare02 Body/Noise; Clap Tone/Width; Closed Hat Tone/Decay; Open Hat Tone/Decay; Low/High Tom Tone/Decay; Rim Tone/Room; Shaker Tone/Decay; Perc Hit Tone/Space. concept-library-rules.title: Library rules (Appendix B)
concept-library-rules.content: FACTORY: bundled read-only; edit always creates User copy; cannot delete factory assets. USER: saved sounds from edited factory, mic recordings, or imports. RECORDED/IMPORTED: filters inside User for mic vs import sources — not separate copies. FAVORITES: references to Factory or User; removing favorite never deletes sound. SOURCE AUDIO: stored once; multiple user sounds may reference with different trim/tune/EQ. DELETE: only when no project or user sound references item; destructive confirmation mandatory. EXPORT: user sample sources as WAV via browser download; Rendered Copy applies edits else Source Export original. STORAGE: persistent browser storage; show usage; warn before pressure causes recording failure.

concept-sound-engine.title: Sound engine semantics (Appendix C)
concept-sound-engine.content: TONE/CUTOFF: darker low / brighter high harmonics. RESONANCE: boost around cutoff. ATTACK: time to full level. RELEASE: fade after key release. BASS EQ: low-shelf ~120Hz -12..+12dB. TREBLE EQ: high-shelf ~6kHz -12..+12dB. REVERB: wet amount. DELAY: amount; timing may follow tempo/preset. SAMPLE START/END: region in source buffer. NORMALIZE: peak to safe max, no compression. REVERSE: play region backward. COARSE/FINE TUNE: playback rate — pitch and duration move together in V1 (no pitch-preserving stretch). ROOT NOTE: keyboard note for base pitch. ONE-SHOT: plays to end. GATE: plays while held. LOOP (sample): repeats region until release/stop. TRACK LEVEL: non-destructive loop track volume. PAN: L/R. SWING: delay alternating seq subdivisions. GATE (SEQ): note duration relative to step.

concept-recording-behavior.title: Loop recording behavior (Appendix D)
concept-recording-behavior.content: NEW RECORD: REC while stopped starts selected track after count-in; becomes timing reference if no existing loop. OVERDUB: REC while playing adds pass; REC again stops adding, playback continues. REPLACE: if track mode Replace, next pass replaces after confirm/count-in. PLAY DURING REC ALL: all unmuted tracks audible. MONITORED: only tracks with Monitor ON. OFF: backing silent; metronome may play. UNDO: only most recent record/overdub — not library edits. METRONOME never in recorded audio. MIC SAMPLE MONITOR off by default (feedback). PAD/KEY MONITOR: always hear current performance while recording unless modal blocks input.

concept-persistence.title: Persistence (Appendix E)
concept-persistence.content: GLOBAL SETTINGS: master EQ, limiter preference, metronome click, display, storage permission/status, mic permission cache. PROJECT: BPM, key metadata, keyboard sound, pad assignments, loop tracks, loop options, sequencer patterns, mixer, octave/hold/voice where appropriate. USER SOUND: source ref, trim, tuning/root, playback mode, envelope, EQ, filter/shape, FX, name/favorite. SOURCE AUDIO: mic take or imported file once; referenced by sounds/projects. RECOVERY: rolling autosave of session. FACTORY LIBRARY: read-only app assets. Browser: IndexedDB or OPFS for media/state; request persistent storage; file picker/download for import/export. Manual should not expose implementation names unless troubleshooting.

concept-v1-boundaries.title: V1 boundaries (Appendix F)
concept-v1-boundaries.content: NO MIDI CONTROL: no external MIDI dependency; front panel self-contained. NO USB WORKFLOW: charging connector may exist but no USB device-management screen or USB sound import. FILE IMPORT: host browser/OS file picker; then all editing on CASSIO UI. PITCH/TIME: sampler tuning changes playback rate (pitch+duration together); pitch-preserving stretch later. DEEP SYNTHESIS: musical macros not full osc/mod matrix. MORE TRACKS: V1 fixes loop/mixer to six. TOUCH: no core workflow requires touch; native browser dialogs are only host UI exceptions. Hardware can be frozen: all V1 tasks reachable with display, M1/M2/M3, A-D, pads 1-6, BACK/MENU, nav cluster, transport, mini keyboard.

GET THERE: From Sound Library, highlight a sound and press OK/More, or open the current sound's detail action.

concept-screen-06.title: Screen 06: Sound Edit - Shape
concept-screen-06.content:
Screen 06: Sound Edit - Shape.
GET THERE: Sound Detail -> B EDIT. A selects Shape page.
HARDWARE: M1 = cutoff/brightness. M2 = resonance. LEFT/RIGHT or OK can change discrete voice/drive options shown in the lower rows. A/B/C/D jump between Shape, Envelope, EQ and FX pages.
WHAT IT DOES: Cutoff removes or reveals high-frequency content. Resonance emphasizes frequencies around the cutoff. Voice/drive options can make a sound more focused, saturated or mono/poly depending on preset type.
SAVE/STATE: Edits remain pending until BACK; then Save Sound is shown. Factory sources require Save As.
NOTES: Parameter names can vary by factory preset, but V1 should prefer musically obvious controls rather than exposing raw synthesis internals. 11 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-07.title: Screen 07: Sound Edit - Envelope
concept-screen-07.content:
Screen 07: Sound Edit - Envelope.
GET THERE: Sound Edit -> B ENV.
HARDWARE: M1 = Attack. M2 = Release. A/B/C/D switch edit pages.
WHAT IT DOES: Short Attack produces a sharp immediate onset; longer Attack fades into the note. Short Release stops quickly; longer Release creates a tail after the key is released.
SAVE/STATE: Values are saved with a user sound or project sound state.
NOTES: V1 deliberately uses a simple two-control envelope here. More detailed ADSR controls can be added later as digital-only pages. 12 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-08.title: Screen 08: Sound Edit - EQ
concept-screen-08.content:
Screen 08: Sound Edit - EQ.
GET THERE: Sound Edit -> C EQ.
HARDWARE: M1 = Bass, from -12 dB to +12 dB. M2 = Treble, from -12 dB to +12 dB. OK can reset the selected band to 0 dB; a Reset action may reset both.
WHAT IT DOES: Bass boosts/cuts low frequencies using a low-shelf EQ. Treble boosts/cuts high frequencies using a high-shelf EQ. This changes timbre, not note pitch or tempo.
SAVE/STATE: EQ values are stored with the user sound or current project sound state.
NOTES: Recommended implementation: low shelf around 120 Hz and high shelf around 6 kHz. Keep enough headroom/limiting to avoid clipping after boosts. 13 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-09.title: Screen 09: Sound Edit - FX
concept-screen-09.content:
Screen 09: Sound Edit - FX.
GET THERE: Sound Edit -> D FX.
HARDWARE: M1 = Reverb amount. M2 = Delay amount. M3 still controls master volume.
WHAT IT DOES: Reverb adds room/space. Delay adds repeating echoes synchronized or free-running according to preset defaults. At 0% the corresponding effect is bypassed.
SAVE/STATE: Values save with a user sound. Factory preset changes require Save As.
NOTES: Detailed delay time, feedback or reverb type can be later digital pages; V1 only needs the two immediate musical amounts. 14 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-10.title: Screen 10: Save Sound
concept-screen-10.content:
Screen 10: Save Sound.

WHAT IT DOES: Saving does not alter playback except that the edited sound becomes a reusable library item.
SAVE/STATE: User sound stores a reference to its source plus filter/envelope/EQ/FX settings; factory media stays untouched.
NOTES: This non-destructive model prevents accidental loss and keeps factory content immutable. 15 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-11.content:
Screen 11: Pad Assignment.

concept-screen-30.content:
Screen 30: Settings Home.

concept-screen-31.title: Screen 31: Settings - Master Audio
concept-screen-31.content:
Screen 31: Settings - Master Audio.

WHAT IT DOES: Bass/Treble alter the whole device output. Limiter catches peaks caused by stacked tracks/EQ boosts and reduces clipping.
SAVE/STATE: Master EQ and limiter preference persist globally, not per project.
NOTES: Per-sound EQ and master EQ are intentionally separate: one shapes a sound; the other compensates for speakers/headphones or overall taste. 36 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-32.title: Screen 32: Settings - Metronome
concept-screen-32.content:
Screen 32: Settings - Metronome.

WHAT IT DOES: Metronome adds a click to playback/recording monitoring only; it is never recorded into loop audio. Count-in plays before recording begins.
SAVE/STATE: Settings persist globally; a project stores BPM but not necessarily the preferred click sound.
NOTES: Beat 1 may use an accented click so bar boundaries are obvious. 37 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-33.content:
Screen 33: Settings - Display.

concept-screen-34.title: Screen 34: Settings - Storage
concept-screen-34.content:
Screen 34: Settings - Storage.
GET THERE: SETTINGS -> STORAGE.
HARDWARE: A jumps to user samples (same USER library screen). B cleanup. C requests/presents persistent- storage status. D back. Arrows navigate rows.
WHAT IT DOES: No audio effect unless the user deletes an unreferenced sample.
SAVE/STATE: Cleanup may remove orphaned source files only after verifying that no project/user sound references them. Persistent storage requests the browser/device to reduce automatic eviction.
NOTES: Never delete a referenced sample silently. Deletion actions use a confirmation dialog. 39 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-35.title: Screen 35: Settings - Permissions
concept-screen-35.content:
Screen 35: Settings - Permissions.
GET THERE: SETTINGS -> PERMISSIONS.
HARDWARE: A tests mic and shows level meter. B requests permission if available. C shows help text. D back.
WHAT IT DOES: Mic Test meters input; monitoring remains off, so testing should not feed the mic directly to speakers.
SAVE/STATE: Permission state is controlled by the host browser/OS; CASSIO stores only its own preference/status cache.
NOTES: On a dedicated device, microphone access can ideally be pre-authorized so the user never sees a browser permission prompt. 40 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-36.title: Screen 36: About
concept-screen-36.content:
Screen 36: About.
GET THERE: SETTINGS -> ABOUT.
HARDWARE: D/Back returns. Other soft keys may be blank in a production build unless diagnostics are deliberately exposed.
WHAT IT DOES: No audio effect.
SAVE/STATE: No musical state changes.
NOTES: The production screen should identify the device as a pocket synth/sampler and list Web Audio, onboard microphone, file import and local storage capabilities. 41 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-37.title: Screen 37: Microphone Blocked
concept-screen-37.content:
Screen 37: Microphone Blocked.
GET THERE: Appears after Mic Record or Mic Test when browser permission is denied/unavailable.
HARDWARE: A back, B open Permissions page, C retry, D help. REC remains disabled until permission is available.
WHAT IT DOES: No mic audio is captured. Existing instrument/loop playback is unaffected.
SAVE/STATE: No recording is created.
NOTES: The error must explain the next action instead of failing silently. 42 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-screen-38.title: Screen 38: Destructive Confirmation
concept-screen-38.content:
Screen 38: Destructive Confirmation.
GET THERE: Appears only after a destructive action.
HARDWARE: A cancel. D confirm destructive action. The middle soft keys remain blank unless the specific action needs another choice.
WHAT IT DOES: Sound changes only after confirmation. Cancelling returns exactly to the previous state.
SAVE/STATE: Deletion/clear is committed only after D confirm. Referenced samples cannot be deleted; CASSIO should identify the blocking project/sound.
NOTES: Using one consistent destructive-dialog pattern reduces accidental data loss. 43 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL

concept-area-play.title: PLAY area
concept-area-play.content: Top-level PLAY: performance home Screen 02; Library shortcut to Sound Library; Sound Detail; Sound Edit; Pad Assign. Soft path D LIBRARY from PLAY.

concept-area-loop.title: LOOP area
concept-area-loop.content: Top-level LOOP: Track View (6 tracks), Track Menu (overdub/replace/monitor/mute/solo/level/pan), Loop Options (length/quantize/count-in/play-during-rec/metronome/tempo), Step Sequencer + Step Edit.

concept-area-sound.title: SOUND area
concept-area-sound.content: Top-level SOUND: Sound Library/Detail/Edit; Sampler Home -> Mic Record or Import File -> Sample Edit (trim/tools/tune/playback/EQ) -> Save Sample; Pad Assign.

concept-area-mix.title: MIX area
concept-area-mix.content: Top-level MIX: six-track mixer with level/pan, mute/solo; M3 remains master volume.

concept-area-project.title: PROJECT area
concept-area-project.content: Top-level PROJECT: project list, New/Save/Save As/Rename/Open; Text Entry for names; recovery autosave.

concept-area-settings.title: SETTINGS area
concept-area-settings.content: Top-level SETTINGS: Master Audio EQ, Metronome, Display, Storage, Permissions (mic), About. Also Mic Blocked and Destructive Confirmation patterns.

concept-workflow-play-sound.title: Workflow: Play a sound
concept-workflow-play-sound.content: Boot -> PLAY -> D LIBRARY -> choose sound -> OK -> A USE KEYS. Use keyboard; A/B shift octave.

concept-workflow-record-mic.title: Workflow: Record mic sample
concept-workflow-record-mic.content: Hold MENU -> SOUND -> D SAMPLER -> A MIC -> REC -> STOP -> trim/tune/mode/EQ -> save.

concept-workflow-import.title: Workflow: Import sample
concept-workflow-import.content: Hold MENU -> SOUND -> D SAMPLER -> B FILE -> D OPEN -> choose system file -> edit -> save. Formats WAV/MP3/OGG/M4A per browser decoder.

concept-workflow-make-loop.title: Workflow: Make a loop
concept-workflow-make-loop.content: Hold MENU -> LOOP -> select track -> REC -> perform -> REC to exit overdub -> PLAY/STOP as needed.

concept-workflow-step-program.title: Workflow: Step program
concept-workflow-step-program.content: LOOP -> B SEQ -> pad selects lane -> arrows select step -> OK toggles step.

concept-workflow-save-project.title: Workflow: Save project
concept-workflow-save-project.content: Hold MENU -> PROJECT -> B SAVE; use Text Entry if naming a new project.

instruction-pdf-graphed.title: PDF fully graphed into grapher (Phase 1)
instruction-pdf-graphed.content: Phase 1 complete: CASSIO_V1_Complete_Operating_Manual.pdf read from primary text and manual-assets images; structured concepts stored in grapher for scope, hardware, global behavior, navigation, all Screens 01-38, factory library, Glass Poly, library rules, sound engine, recording, persistence, boundaries, six areas, and fast workflows. Graphify-out was purged and must not be used. Phase 2 (Rails Milestone A) must consult these nodes via grapher search/get/neighbors.

finding-pdf-graph-complete.title: Operating manual structured in grapher
finding-pdf-graph-complete.content: Full V1 operating manual is now represented as grapher concepts (not graphify cache): core domains, Screens 01-38, six menu areas, six workflows, linked to PDF document and depicting screen images. Ready for Rails Milestone A build to consult grapher.

finding-rails-milestone-a.title: Rails Milestone A implemented
finding-rails-milestone-a.content: Rails 8.1 Hotwire/Stimulus instrument at repo root. GET / serves hardware shell (pink chassis, LCD, M1/M2/M3, A-D, pads, BACK/MENU, D-pad+OK, transport, mini keyboard). Client Web Audio: AudioEngine + GlassPolyVoice (brightness/space). Screens: Boot (factory JSON + IndexedDB recovery + gesture resume), PLAY (octave/hold/library stub), Menu (six areas; only PLAY live). Persistence: IndexedDB recovery store. Factory: public/factory/sounds.json. Consulted grapher concepts screen-01/02/03, hardware-front-panel, glass-poly, persistence. No graphify.

finding-ui-keyboard-vscreen-pwa.title: Keyboard drag, V-screen UI, portrait gate, splash, PWA icons
finding-ui-keyboard-vscreen-pwa.content: UI polish pass: mini-keyboard uses pointer capture + elementFromPoint drag (no stuck notes; Hold respected). Viewport fit via scale into 100dvh with overflow hidden. All transient messages on V-screen overlay only (external toast/hint removed). Landscape on phone/tablet shows PORTRAIT ONLY gate. Splash on V-screen then boot/audio. PWA: public/icons/* + manifest portrait/standalone, theme #ff2d7a.

finding-ui-fullbleed-layout.title: Full-bleed chassis; mid-row never stacks
finding-ui-fullbleed-layout.content: Phone layout: chassis is width/height 100% (100dvh) with safe-area padding; no min(400px) cap or transform scale fit. Mid-row always 2 columns (pads | nav) — removed max-width 480px stack that jumbled controls. Pads use equal grid rows not fixed aspect-ratio. Desktop (>=720px) soft-caps chassis to ~430x860 centered. fitChassis() clears transform only.

finding-ui-knobs-viz-autoboot.title: Knob rotate, bit-wave viz, auto boot
finding-ui-knobs-viz-autoboot.content: M1/M2/M3 knobs rotate -135..+135 mapped to brightness/space/masterVolume. PLAY V-screen has full-width pixelated canvas oscilloscope (AnalyserNode on master); flat line when silent. Boot auto-advances splash→factory→recovery→audio→PLAY with no tap-to-start; AudioContext resume deferred to first pad/key/PLAY via ensureAudioRunning. Tap retry only on bootError.

finding-octave-remap-held-midi.title: Octave remaps held keys; stacked drone is future FX
finding-octave-remap-held-midi.content: Bug: keyUp/padUp recomputed MIDI from current octave so after A/B OCT shift, noteOff missed the sounding voice and pitches stacked into a thick bass drone. Fix: heldKeys/heldPads are Map(degree|pad→midi); release uses stored midi; soft A/B call remapHeldNotes (immediate off old, on new). Octave range stays -3..+3 for intentional super-bass. The accidental stacked old+new drone is a candidate future sound-library FX (octave stack / hold-stack), not default PLAY behavior. HOLD keeps map entries so remaps still apply to latched notes.

finding-ui-boot-knobs-brand-0926.title: Boot no-await resume; chonky knobs; studio-0926
finding-ui-boot-knobs-brand-0926.content: Boot hang: await AudioContext.resume() without gesture never resolved — start() now fire-and-forget resume, ready=true, PLAY advances; ensureAudioRunning resumes on first pad/key/PLAY. Knobs: public/knobs/knob.png matte black + pink hash, recessed bay, slight LCD column squeeze (top-row 1fr + ~4.5rem). Brand: studio - 0926 lighter sheen right of CASSIO. Pads aspect-ratio 1; taller keyboard; larger d-pad/OK.

finding-ui-layout-menu-wave-topknob.title: Nav left/pads right; top-down knobs; BACK/MENU; live wave
finding-ui-layout-menu-wave-topknob.content: UX layout: mid-row is nav-cluster (BACK / MENU one-line, larger d-pad/OK, transport) on LEFT and pads 1-6 on RIGHT for natural handedness (differs from cover photo pads-left). Knobs use orthographic top-down PNG so rotate looks correct. Keyboard row grows to near chassis bottom (grid fr + height 100%, reduced bottom pad). BACK/MENU: tap opens menu from PLAY and closes from menu; hold also opens; label is single-line BACK / MENU. V-screen viz is continuous pink oscilloscope stroke+soft fill scaled by RMS and masterVolume, shape from live analyser waveform (not stepped bit columns).

finding-ui-brand-keys-balance.title: Shorter keys; matte-gloss brand; dark pink model
finding-ui-brand-keys-balance.content: Keyboard height capped again (clamp ~3.7–4.5rem, chassis last row auto) so mid-row nav/pads are not squished. Brand CASSIO and model studio-0926 use matte-gloss gradient text + soft highlight drop-shadow. Model is dark pink (#9a1848 family), readable clamp ~0.62–0.78rem, smaller than logo.

finding-ui-keyboard-height-50pct.title: Keyboard height +50% from short clamp
finding-ui-keyboard-height-50pct.content: Keyboard height set to clamp(5.55rem, 15.75vh, 6.75rem) — exactly 50% taller than the prior short clamp(3.7rem, 10.5vh, 4.5rem). Do not swing back to fr-growing full-bleed keys or the undersized 3.7rem band without user ask.

finding-ui-no-text-select.title: Disable text selection on instrument UI
finding-ui-no-text-select.content: cassio-body/stage and all descendants use user-select:none, -webkit-touch-callout:none, tap-highlight transparent; selectstart prevented on root. Stops accidental text highlight while tapping/dragging controls.

finding-ui-overhead-knob-realestate.title: Overhead knob shadow; bottom slack into V-screen
finding-ui-overhead-knob-realestate.content: Knob shadow is overhead-centered under-shadow (0 3px 5px + thin rim), no hard 0 3px 0 side ledge. Chassis bottom padding is safe-area only (no extra 0.2rem); gap 0.28rem; grid top-row 1.25fr / mid 1.1fr so V-screen grows. Keyboard height unchanged clamp(5.55rem, 15.75vh, 6.75rem) per finding-ui-keyboard-height-50pct.

finding-ui-pitch-wheel-nav-align.title: Studio pitch wheel; mid-row pad alignment
finding-ui-pitch-wheel-nav-align.content: Added spring-return PITCH wheel (±2 semitones) under tightened M1–M3 stack in side-controls (Studio UX; not in V1 hardware legend). GlassPolyVoice.setPitchBend uses osc detune cents on live voices. Mid-row: pads align-content space-between; nav-cluster justify space-between so BACK/MENU top matches pad top and transport bottom matches pad bottom; d-pad flexes middle.

finding-ui-equal-spacing-se-scale.title: Equal M1–PITCH gaps; d-pad scale; SE-safe clamps
finding-ui-equal-spacing-se-scale.content: side-controls: justify center; shared clamp(0.2rem,1.2vh,0.35rem) gap on knobs and side-controls; removed pitch margin-top auto so M1/M2/M3/PITCH spacing is equal. D-pad/OK use min(vw,vh) in clamp so they grow on tall phones but stay compact on SE-class short viewports. Knobs, pitch wheel, keyboard, BACK, transport also vh-capped. max-height 700px media tightens chassis/mid-row gaps.

finding-hold-toggle-sticky-pitch.title: HOLD re-press toggles; pitch sticky until tap
finding-hold-toggle-sticky-pitch.content: With HOLD on: re-pressing a latched key/pad noteOffs and clears that latch (toggle). Keys stay visually active while latched. Pitch wheel does not spring-return while HOLD on; a near-zero-movement tap resets bend to 0. HOLD off clears notes, restores pitch spring-return, and centers bend.

finding-ui-midrow-axis-tighten.title: Pads/nav tightened toward mid-row center
finding-ui-midrow-axis-tighten.content: Pad grid gap reduced to ~0.24rem (0.18rem on max-height 700px). Shared --mid-inset 0.22rem on .mid-row; .pads and .nav-cluster use width calc(100% - 2*inset) + margin-inline auto so BACK/MENU and transport track the same horizontal footprint as the pad block toward the center axis.

finding-ui-pad-row-gap-pack.title: Pad rows use equal gap not space-between
finding-ui-pad-row-gap-pack.content: Root cause of huge vertical pad gaps was align-content:space-between stretching 3 pad rows across full mid-row height. Pads now height:auto, align-self/align-content center, uniform gap 0.24rem (row=col). Nav-cluster similarly centered with justify-content:center and dpad flex 0 so BACK/transport sit close to the cluster axis matching pad density.

finding-ui-mid-panel-flush.title: mid-panel flushes BACK/transport to pad block
finding-ui-mid-panel-flush.content: mid-row wraps nav+pads in .mid-panel (flex stretch). Pads keep uniform 0.24rem gap and content height; nav-cluster stretches to that height with justify space-between so BACK top and transport bottom flush with pad block. Shared --mid-inset for horizontal footprint.
